Name: ZH's Artisanal Goods Plus - Rose's Large Animals Produce
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/8epcgKy.png[/img]﻿[/center]
﻿﻿
Finally here, it's a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29535]ZH's Artisanal Goods+[/url] add-on for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/204150728]Roseloves109[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28864]Rose's Large Cheese and Mayonnaise[/url], it can be used without [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29535]ZH's Artisanal Goods+[/url]﻿ but made to match with it. Yes, this does the same thing as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33098]ZH's Artisanal Goods+ - Quality Goods[/url] but I just decided to keep it a separate mod, so use this mod here if you play with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28864]Rose's Large Cheese and Mayonnaise[/url].

This mod, like my others, is completely [i]configurable[/i]. Anything you don't like or want, you can simply disable alongside choose what style and colour you want.



[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/dIibzU8.png[/img][/center]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28864]Rose's Large Cheese and Mayonnaise[/url].﻿
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy configurations
4. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it
5. When starting the game for the first time since installing, use Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the mod to your liking

You're all done and ready to play.
